motivation: The live 78-species initial search has 6084 directed species tasks and uses four workers with eight scoring threads each. A passive sample found about 25 scoring core equivalents, but non-blocking stack profiling was denied. Measure stage costs in a separate bounded process before proposing a computational optimization.

cohort.species: Three FASTA filenames with smallest SHA256(filename) among the frozen QfO inputs; no reference labels or outcome-based selection.
cohort.pairs: Cyclic directed comparisons A->B, B->C, C->A in selected-species hash order.
cohort.query_selection: Smallest SHA256(gene identifier), restored to original FASTA order for encoding and local-index interpretation.
cohort.targets: Complete corresponding target proteome, not a truncated database.

execution: For each pair and cap, run the native search once without wrappers and once with transparent timing wrappers. Require byte-identical indices, scores, E-values and candidate counts. Timing wrappers return the original result unchanged, preserve exceptions and record inclusive stage costs; do not alter search code or running benchmarks.
report: selected gene identifiers and original indices
native output fingerprints and instrumentation-equivalence checks
selection_rule: Use measured costs only to prioritize a future bounded, opt-in, output-preserving computational experiment. No new default, accuracy selection, reference-family exception, full-pipeline speedup estimate or extrapolated ETA from this probe.
limitations: Reference-free sampling does not make previously examined QfO inputs independent confirmation.
Tiny query subsets and three species comparisons are not representative of all 6084 tasks or all protein lengths.
Uninstrumented first runs and instrumented second runs have different warm-up/cache conditions; their total times must not be interpreted as an optimization contrast.
Inclusive stages may contain nested work. Do not sum overlapping stage intervals or claim isolated/shared-host speed rankings.
Significant-hit counts are not orthology accuracy; actual full-search cap trials and component phylogeny benchmarks remain authoritative for those endpoints.
No source or parameters of live jobs, no scientific environment packages, and no unrelated workloads may be changed.
